scope.objective: Bound Piagent-owned helpers, retrieval and subagent orchestration to recommend-first authority, read-only automatic work, finite budgets, one-writer ownership, isolated redacted summaries, cancellation and parent-owned merge.

reviewedIdentity.head: 4f37ae05d56431f2f9db9c4159e20252c3da3b2a
reviewedIdentity.workingTreeDisposition: Dirty user-owned full-source development tree retained. This artifact binds the exact current helper/retrieval carriers and provider-free verification only; it is not a clean or frozen release candidate.

productionContract.broadDefault: CAP-14 recommend/advise and CAP-15 off; recommendation adds zero adapter or provider turns and never dispatches automatically.
productionContract.automaticOptIn: CAP-14 on permits at most one read-only automatic helper dispatch per task/run. Automatic workers remain disabled.
productionContract.explicitOwnedWork: The lower-level controller permits at most two concurrent and three total explicitly owned reservations, one pass per bounded role, and one active writer.
productionContract.retrieval: Retrieval recommendations use grep/find/read only, at most two parallel searches and two rounds, never automatic dispatch and never wider parent scope.
productionContract.permissionInheritance: A child preserves the parent catalog identity, allowed tools, approval restrictions and scope; absolute paths, traversal, wildcard broadening and undeclared regions are rejected.
productionContract.resultOwnership: A successful helper exposes only a redacted normalized summary capped at 1000 characters. The parent is the sole merge owner; durable state stores only bounded counters and a raw-output digest.
productionContract.failurePolicy: Timeout, cancellation, terminal-parent late result, stale reservation, call/token overflow, unavailable model, duplicate work and orphan recovery all fail closed without merging output.
productionContract.rollback: Set CAP-14 off or recommend and keep CAP-15 off for a clean replacement task. Existing receipts remain evidence; Task Contract, tool schema and persisted state require no migration.

implementation.change: Enforced explicit and automatic ceilings, deduplication, one-writer ownership, orphan/terminal handling, late-result rejection, and call/token result budgets.
Added actual timeout/abort/cancel behavior, one-dispatch automatic budget, stale/overflow rejection, redacted bounded summary and parent-only merge ownership.
Made scope inheritance conservative and rejected absolute, traversal, wildcard-broadening and undeclared child paths.
Bound every route to at most two parallel read-only searches and two rounds with automatic dispatch false.
Replaced hard-coded safety metrics with deterministic lifecycle, timeout, cancellation, orphan, budget, writer and privacy probes.
Covered zero-turn recommendation, one automatic dispatch, actual timeout/cancel/stale/overflow handling and redacted summary merge.
Covered direct result overflow, late release, concurrency, stale-lock recovery, orphan and terminal behavior.
Covered traversal, absolute, additional-scope rejection and valid narrowed child scope.
Covered the full helpers-mode/confidence matrix, finite ceilings and no automatic dispatch.
Required actual evaluation probes, bounded metrics and private-value exclusion.
Documented helper authority, budgets, privacy, parent merge and 2x2 retrieval limits.
Kept the Vietnamese production contract aligned with the English authority and retrieval limits.
Separated one automatic dispatch from explicit owned reservations and documented fail-closed merge behavior.
Regenerated the exact production runtime-integrity lock.

exitEvidence.evidence: Recommend mode invokes no adapter/provider; on mode admits one read-only automatic dispatch per task/run; worker and parent routing remain off.
Request context, calls and timeout are enforced at execution/result merge; overflow and timeout cannot contribute output.
Child scope/tools cannot widen the parent; explicit owner budget serializes the writer and cross-process reservations.
Parent terminal aborts active work; late/stale adapter success is rejected; orphan recovery does not create extra budget.
Raw prompts, outputs and session identity are absent from durable evidence; only a digest/counters persist and the parent owns a redacted 1000-character maximum summary.
Six deterministic 5000-file cases passed with 37.27% median time-to-relevant-file improvement and equal verified pass rate; this is local mechanics evidence only, not provider/model/token evidence.
